documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Disclosures under Reg. 10(6) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot

analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a 15.65% increase in operating income to Rs. 1,58,563.68 Lakhs for the financial year 2025-26, alongside an EBITDA of Rs. 46,710.23 Lakhs and a Profit After Tax of Rs. 24,446.00 Lakhs. The board approved the construction of a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises, with work expected to commence in the second quarter of 2026.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that global healthcare demand is continuing to rise due to aging populations, rapid medical technology advancements, and increasing patient expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: As global healthcare demand continues to rise—driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations—healthcare providers are under mounting pressure to develop cutting-edge hospitals, clinics, and medical campuses within tighter budgets and accelerated timelines.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted high demand for admission to the medical school, with all seats being filled.
demand_outlook.quote: Their reputation has become so esteemed that there is now high demand for admission to this prestigious medical school, with all seats being filled.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the construction of a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block represents a capital investment of Rs. 120 Crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore, this state-of-the-art facility operates as a vertical hub of medical excellence.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made a Rs. 47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics.
capex_expansion.quote: We launched Tamil Nadu’s first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system, part of a ₹47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics and continue to lead the state in performing CAR-T cell therapies.

capex_expansion.claim: Investment in equipment during the year 2025-26 amounts to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2025-26 amounts to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The hospital plans to add another 100 beds in the main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

capex_expansion.claim: The Outpatient (OP) block in Chennai will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made a significant investment of Rs. 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024–25.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its ongoing commitment to adopt cutting-edge medical technologies, your company made a significant investment of ₹ 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024–25.

capex_expansion.claim: Total investment in equipment during the year 2024-25 amounts to Rs. 3,358.36 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2024-25 amounts to ₹ 3,358.36 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch with added cath lab and MRI facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch of Kovai Medical Center now have added cath lab and MRI facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to 5239.02 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, the company has expanded its capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.

margins_costs.claim: The hospital posted an EBITDA margin of 29% and a sustained PAT margin of 15%.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The profit margin for the year was reported at 15%.
The biogas production initiative results in reduced LPG costs.
margins_costs.quote: This initiative not only effectively manages waste but also results in reduced LPG costs, contributing to both environmental sustainability and cost savings.

orders_capacity.claim: The hospital completed 75 ECMO runs in 2025.
orders_capacity.quote: In critical care, we recorded a landmark 75 ECMO runs in 2025 — the highest in Tamil Nadu — and became only the second hospital in the state to offer an “ECMO on Wheels” ambulance service.

orders_capacity.claim: The orthopedic team achieved 1,000 robotic-assisted knee replacements using the CORI Advanced Robotic system.
orders_capacity.quote: Our orthopedic team achieved the remarkable milestone of 1,000 robotic-assisted knee replacements so far using the CORI Advanced Robotic system.

orders_capacity.claim: The hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ₹15/- per share for the Financial Year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The Company has not accepted any deposits from the public or its members during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: As per Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the Companies (Acceptance of Deposits), Rules 2014, the Company has not accepted any deposits from the public or its members during the year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Company has neither provided nor there were any outstanding loans or guarantees covered under Section 186.
capital_allocation.quote: As on March 31, 2026, the Company has neither provided nor there were any outstanding loans or guarantees covered under the provisions of Section 186 of the Companies Act 2013.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a 100% dividend.
The Board has recommended a dividend of Rs. 10 per share for the Financial Year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹ 10/- per share (100 %) for the Financial Year 2024-25 for approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is seeking to enhance borrowing limits to Rs. 2500 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Therefore, it is considered desirable to enhance the borrowing limits to ` 2500 crore (Rupees Two thousand five hundred crore only) apart from temporary loans obtained / to be obtained by the company from its Bankers in the ordinary course of business.

risks_headwinds.claim: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless technology integration, and round-the-clock operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges, including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and the need for uninterrupted, round-the-clock operations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Significant investments required to attract and retain qualified medical professionals have put pressure on cash flow.
risks_headwinds.quote: Significant investments are required to attract and retain qualified medical professionals, technicians, and skilled medical staff which has put pressure on our cash flow.

risks_headwinds.claim: Hiring qualified professionals becomes increasingly difficult as demand outpaces supply.
risks_headwinds.quote: Hiring qualified professionals becomes increasingly difficult as demand outpaces supply.

management_commitments.claim: The construction work for the 300 bed Paediatric Hospital may commence during the second quarter 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the OP block in Chennai will be ready for operation by the end of this year.
management_commitments.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

management_commitments.claim: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.
management_commitments.quote: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.

management_commitments.claim: Management expressed focus on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.
management_commitments.quote: We are also focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
